faq.q: What Tammy Wynette song is in GTA 6 Trailer 2?
faq.a: "Talkin' to Myself Again" plays briefly on a car radio during the trailer's driving montage. It is a country single Tammy Wynette released in November 1987 from the album Higher Ground.

faq.q: What other songs were identified alongside Talkin' to Myself Again in GTA 6 Trailer 2?
faq.a: NME identified it as one of three short radio snippets during Jason's driving montage, alongside tracks by Wang Chung and Zenglen.

faq.q: Is Talkin' to Myself Again an official GTA 6 soundtrack credit?
faq.a: No. As with the other background snippets identified in the same montage, this identification is a press finding rather than a confirmed line from an official Rockstar tracklist.
